highlights: The update window now shows the version you have, the new version, its release date and what changed
Downloading an update shows a progress bar, and the game stays usable if the download fails or stalls
A downloaded update is checked against its published checksum before it is started, and is deleted if it does not match
A setup left over from an update that was interrupted is removed the next time the game starts
A failed update check at start-up no longer leaves the menus locked
Fixed a critical bug that prevented video export on Windows
Improved performance on the pose screen by simplifying unnecessary alpha blending
Fixed the opacity selector of the secondary shadow
Merged the Android releases into one larger package to reduce confusion
Changed the Windows file naming scheme to be clearer for non-technical users
Improved UI hitboxes on touchscreen devices
Added PNG strip export on Android
Enabled video and GIF export on Windows
Fixed scaling issues when exporting at resolutions other than 1080p
Added an option to change the preview resolution on Android
Fixed missing feedback after an import succeeded or failed
Fixed several image locations not working on Android
Made the arranger work within the correct aspect ratio
Fixed various other bugs
Fixed portraits not loading
Fixed some animation timings
Added PNG sequence export
Made extensive behind-the-scenes changes
First release
First public release of Redmond Calculator, a cross-platform Fluent-style calculator that reuses the Microsoft Calculator engine.
Standard, scientific, programmer, date calculation, unit conversion and graphing modes, with calculation history.
Optional currency conversion from a source you choose; nothing is contacted before you agree, and amounts are always calculated on your device.
The Settings page lists every open source component and its license, including Microsoft Calculator.
Installs for the current user on Windows 10 (version 1607) or newer, 64-bit, with a signed setup.
